09c2cbede158af3479d9.en: * This article was originally intended to be a paid membership-only article, but it will be free in light of the content. I hope it will be widely read. A notice of the bombing arrived at the school attended by Kensaku Genta's children, who were elected governors of Okinawa Prefecture. The media reported on September 18, and the prefectural police are also investigating (source: Okinawa Times 2026/9/18). On the 19th, Furuka himself made a comment. "If you don't refuse to take office as governor, schools and prefectural governments related to your family...
